query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) AS nid, MIN(parallax) AS pmin, MAX(parallax) AS pmax, MIN(dist_deg) AS dmin, MAX(dist_deg) AS dmax FROM gaia_dr3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw, COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) AS uniq FROM gaia_dr3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE astrometric_params_solved IN (31,95) AND ruwe < 1.4 AND parallax_over_error > 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(bp_rp) AS n_bprp, MIN(parallax), MAX(parallax) FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE astrometric_params_solved IN (31,95) AND ruwe < 1.4 AND parallax_over_error > 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw, COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) AS distinct_ids, SUM(parallax IS NULL) AS null_plx, SUM(pmra IS NULL OR pmdec IS NULL) AS null_pm, SUM(bp_rp IS NULL) AS null_bprp FROM gaia_dr3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(bp_rp IS NULL) AS null_bp_rp, SUM(bp_rp IS NOT NULL) AS cmd_rows FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE astrometric_params_solved IN (31,95) AND ruwe < 1.4 AND parallax_over_error > 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(bp_rp IS NULL) AS null_bp_rp FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE astrometric_params_solved IN (31,95) AND ruwe < 1.4 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NULL
SELECT astrometric_params_solved, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(parallax) AS min_plx, MIN(parallax_over_error) AS min_poe, COUNT(pmra) AS n_pmra FROM gaia_dr3 GROUP BY astrometric_params_solved
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) AS n_ids FROM gaia_dr3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaia_dr3
SELECT cmd_group, COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaia_clean WHERE bp_rp IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cmd_group
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pleiades_members
SELECT cmd_group, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(bp_rp IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL) AS n_plotted FROM gaia_clean GROUP BY cmd_group
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_where FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE astrometric_params_solved IN (31, 95) AND ruwe < 1.4 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_clean_where FROM gaia_clean WHERE bp_rp IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_members_in_clean, SUM(g.cmd_group='Member') AS flagged FROM pleiades_members p LEFT JOIN gaia_clean g ON g.source_id=p.source_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) AS nd FROM gaia_clean
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_quality FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE astrometric_params_solved IN (31,95) AND ruwe<1.4 AND parallax_over_error>10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_members_no_bprp FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group='Member' AND (bp_rp IS NULL OR phot_g_mean_mag IS NULL)
SELECT MIN(phot_g_mean_mag), MAX(phot_g_mean_mag) FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group='Member'
SELECT cmd_group, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(bp_rp IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL) AS n_cmd FROM gaia_clean GROUP BY cmd_group
SELECT source_id, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, parallax FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group='Member' ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag LIMIT 6

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_G_below_5_2_in_extract, SUM(astrometric_params_solved IN (31,95)) AS five_or_six, SUM(ruwe<1.4) AS ruwe_ok, SUM(parallax_over_error>10) AS poe_gt10, MIN(phot_g_mean_mag) AS gmin FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 5.2
SELECT source_id, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, astrometric_params_solved, ruwe, parallax_over_error, parallax FROM gaia_dr3 WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 6.5 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pleiades_members) AS members_all, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pleiades_members WHERE bp_rp IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL) AS members_plot, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaia_clean) AS clean_all, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group='Member') AS clean_member, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group='Field') AS clean_field, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group='Field' AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL) AS field_plot, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaia_clean WHERE cmd_group IS NULL) AS null_group
